description: Use this when the user asks how a creator campaign is performing or for its report. One campaign's report: spend against budget, posts, approved views, cost per 1,000 views, each creator's posts, views, earnings and payout status, top posts and the authenticity spread. format "csv" returns it as CSV (rows "creators" or "posts", money in US dollars) plus a download link. view "ledger": every money movement, newest first (earned, held to payable, paid with the Stripe transfer, cancelled, bonuses and deductions, owed back and recovered, fees); filter by participantId or kind. view "ad_results": what the campaign's posts did as ads (spend, impressions, clicks, purchases, ROAS) per post and per creator ranked by rankBy, read now from the brand's ad accounts. Read-only, free.
name: creator_campaign_report
title: Creator campaign report (CSV too)
